verdict.rationale: Open-source licensing is a fair question for a scheduling product, since alternatives in this category can be self-hosted or open source. However, nothing in the evidence shows Calendly publishes its source under an open license. The pack covers only proprietary APIs, embeds, webhooks and an MCP server, none of which is source availability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
